Method of Attack: Distributed through SPAM emails pretending to be shipping notifications
Redirects to fake Microsoft Word Online site prompting download of malicious plugin
Execution of downloaded plugin installs Mole ransomware
Displays fake alert to coerce UAC prompt approval for administrative privileges
Generates unique victim ID and retrieves RSA-1024 public key from C2 server
Stops security services and disables Windows recovery features
Encrypts targeted files using AES-256 and appends .MOLE extension
Creates ransom note INSTRUCTION_FOR_HELPING_FILE_RECOVERY.TXT in encrypted folders
Attack Vector: SPAM email with shipping notification theme containing malicious link
Fake Microsoft Word Online document prompting plugin download and execution
Indicators of Compromise: Stopped services: wscsvc, WinDefend, wuauserv, BITS, ERSvc, WerSvc
Commands issued: vssadmin.exe Delete Shadows /All /Quiet, bcdedit /set {default} recoveryenabled No, bcdedit /set {default} bootstatuspolicy ignoreallfailures
